youtube.title: How Cleopatra actually met Julius Caesar (in a carpet) 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
How Cleopatra met Julius Caesar: she couldn't get past her brother's guards... so she shipped herself. 🧶📦

Caesar ordered nothing. A rug showed up. The rug had a queen inside.

Would you have opened the rug? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Plutarch's story: in 48 BC Apollodorus the Sicilian smuggled Cleopatra into the palace in Alexandria rolled up in a bedroll to meet Caesar.

#cleopatra #juliuscaesar #caesarandcleopatra #ancienthistory #romanhistory #historymemes #shorts
